commands.title: Usage

preferences.name: showClaude
preferences.label: Show Claude
preferences.description: Show Claude usage in the list

preferences.name: showCodex
preferences.label: Show Codex
preferences.description: Show Codex usage in the list

preferences.name: additionalCodexHomes
preferences.title: Additional Codex Homes (Optional)
preferences.description: Comma-separated CODEX_HOME directories to include in addition to the default Codex home

preferences.name: showCopilot
preferences.label: Show Copilot
preferences.description: Show Copilot usage in the list

preferences.name: copilotAuthToken
preferences.title: Copilot Authorization Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback OAuth token for Copilot usage. Usually auto-detected from GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN. Standard PATs may not work.

preferences.name: showCursor
preferences.label: Show Cursor
preferences.description: Show Cursor usage in the list

preferences.name: cursorCookieHeader
preferences.title: Cursor Cookie Header (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback Cookie header from cursor.com. Usually auto-detected from your local Cursor.app login.

preferences.name: showDeepSeek
preferences.label: Show DeepSeek
preferences.description: Show DeepSeek balance in the list

preferences.name: deepseekApiKey
preferences.title: DeepSeek API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Auto-detected from OpenCode login (deepseek) or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY/DEEPSEEK_KEY. Fallback: paste an API key from https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys.

preferences.name: showGemini
preferences.label: Show Gemini
preferences.description: Show Gemini usage in the list

preferences.name: showOpencodeGo
preferences.label: Show OpenCode Go
preferences.description: Show OpenCode Go subscription usage in the list

preferences.name: opencodegoApiKey
preferences.title: OpenCode Go API Key (Recommended)
preferences.description: Your OpenCode Go API key. Get it from https://opencode.ai/settings. Alternatively, set OPENCODE_API_KEY in your shell.

preferences.name: showZai
preferences.label: Show z.ai (GLM)
preferences.description: Show z.ai (GLM) usage in the list

preferences.name: zaiApiToken
preferences.title: z.ai API Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback token. Usually auto-detected from ZAI_API_KEY or GLM_API_KEY environment variable.

preferences.name: cacheTtl
preferences.title: Cache Duration (Seconds)
preferences.description: Cache duration in seconds for remote API requests. Set to 0 to disable caching.
